newsitem.title: USA: Praxair gets OK for air separation plant sale.
newsitem.headline: Praxair gets OK for air separation plant sale.

text.p: Praxair Inc said Monday it had been notified by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission that it has approved the company's application seeking prior approval of the sale of four air separation plants in the U.S. to AGA Gas Inc of Cleveland, a subsidiary of AGA AB of Stockholm, Sweden.

As spreviously reported, under the terms of an FTC consent order, Praxair was obligated to divest the former Liquid Carbonic air separation plants, assets and businesses located at Vacaville, Calif., Irwindale, Calif., Madison, Wis., and Bozrah, Conn.
A statement from Praxair says it and AGA intend to close the deal promptly.
